prompt: Composition: Persistent navigation, dense results table, selected-item inspector, restrained headings. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in Inter; architectural sans heading with neutral interface text. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
